title.en: Endogenous turning, pooled clearing margins, and the epistemic silence boundary

statement.en: Frontier selection over marginal-yield options derives substrate overdraw; non-oracle ServiceTaskModel thresholds turn endogenously within open Clearing and OpenComposition interfaces while epistemic silence breaks turning.

laws.en: Derived selection overdraw: optimum_forces_overdraw and proxy_optimum_overdraw_collapse derive finite-time collapse from Optimum.Rising and Requirement.Frontier when higher draw yields higher visible score, while flow_proxy_optimum_collapse bridges through Web.lost_over and PartAWitness contrasts unconstrained collapse against constrained_survives on non-monotone wGivingCap.

Non-oracle task bottleneck and pooled clearing: ServiceTaskModel derives B_task from saturating throughput and operating upkeep (score_crosses_iff, ext_preferred_above, safe_not_preferred_from_B_task); endogenous_turning_kernel and pooled_service_turning_viable prove Viability.Kernel when (H_safe + y_safe) + drawCeiling * (lag + 1) ≤ B_task, contrasted with unpooled_clearer_blind.

Epistemic silence boundaries and shared witness: epistemic_silence_late_bottleneck (B_task ≤ H_safe + y_safe), service_saturated_below_noReturn_silenced, epistemic_silence_masked_unread (ClosedCapture.Unread), and epistemic_silence_cascade prove collapse when turning signals fail or arrive too late; TurningWitness realizes timely survival vs. late and cascade collapses on one shared substrate.

Native L0 OpenComposition bridge: pooled_clearing_open_compose_viable lifts proxyLoop and taskLoop into proxyComponent ⊕ taskPartnerComponent via compose_close_interchange; clearing_partner_reconfig_viable and ReconfigWitness certify heterogeneous live partner swaps via ReconfigProcess; clearing_widening_heals_blindness and widening_heals_witness separate unpooled collapse from widened viability.

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Requires 0 < H_safe + y_safe, RegimeMargin.Meets/FromNothing/AtMost/Keeps on saturating substrates, ServiceTaskModel throughput/upkeep parameters, (H_safe + y_safe) + drawCeiling * (lag + 1) ≤ B_task for timely turning, and both obs_detects₁ and obs_detects₂ for live ReconfigProcess swaps.

does_not_show.en: That real empirical rewards or tasks satisfy ServiceTaskModel margin inequalities (Rule 2 empirical recognition).
Any ethical 'ought' or Unrestricted significance from turning survival or cascade collapse (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails).

detail.en: PartAWitness.unconstrained_collapses vs. constrained_survives: unconstrained frontier maximization crashes from 18 to 0 by step 6, while capped draw survives at 18 forever.

TurningWitness.{timely_survives, late_collapses, cascade_collapses}: on shared wGivingCap from x₀ = 27, B_task = 22 holds ≥ 19 forever, whereas B_task = 8 and masked 3-stage cascade collapse 27 → ... → 0 by step 11.
OpenCompositionBridge.widening_heals_witness: unpooled proxyLoop crashes 27 → 0 while widened proxyComponent ⊕ taskPartnerComponent holds ≥ 9 forever.
